name: Marelli
verdict: Brand of Marelli Holdings Co., Ltd.: KKR was its shareholder until a 2025 debt restructuring, and its principal lenders are to own it on emergence from Chapter 11 in 2026. Nothing found.
note: Technical partner of Nissan Formula E Team (Season 12, logo on the rear wing of both cars) and of the Ducati Lenovo Team. Marelli Holdings filed for Chapter 11 in the US on 11 June 2025; as of October 2026 no emergence announcement was on marelli.com, so ownership sits with the lenders pending emergence.
